title: Local Market Update
description:
Hello, Central Texas!!! What’s the latest housing data for Bell County? The market is heating up, and here are the latest stats for Bell County. Let's first look at what’s happening right here in Belton, Texas. Hi, I'm Gloria Miller with People 1st Realty Group at Real Broker.

At the time of this recording, in Belton, there were 211 active listings, 69 pending homes, and 47 sold homes last month. The average list price was $408,059, and the average sold price for the month was $400,500, while homes were on the market for an average of 82 days.

In Temple, TX, we have 584 active homes, 232 pending, and 142 homes sold this past month after spending an average of 85 days on the market. Homes in Temple sold for an average of $305,124.

To our west in Killeen, TX, we currently have 489 active homes on the market, 246 pending, and 177 sold this past month, with an average of 64 days on the market. The average list price is $258,664, and the average sold price is $254,887.

Let’s take a look at Georgetown, TX, where we have 1,000 active homes, 352 pending, and 241 sold in the past 30 days, with an average of 57 days on the market. The average list price is $513,438, and the average sold price for the month is $503,614.

With the constant shifts, you need an experienced agent to help guide you through your next moves in real estate. Connect with my team today to get more information, and we can strategize what to do with your home. Again, I am Gloria Miller, with People 1st Realty Group at Real Broker - where we put people over profit.
